subject: Surge capacity playbook & regional pool alignment for Optima Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Rivera <john.rivera@optimahealth.com>, Sara Lin <sara.lin@optimahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Surge capacity playbook & regional pool alignment for Optima Health

Hi John / Sara —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Following our discussion, I wanted to put a concise next-step plan in writing so we can move toward a clean Dedicated activation and predictable surge behavior. High-level ask: align on pool topology, autoscale thresholds, and a documented "surge playbook" that Optima can rely on during traffic spikes.

Key items I propose we lock in this week:
- Baseline pool: 8x A100-equivalent GPUs in us-west-2 (reserved for steady throughput)
- Surge band: allow bursting up to 16 GPUs across multipool routing for short windows (policy: 10m min reservation, 2hr max continuous burst unless approved)
- Autoscale triggers: CPU/GPU utilization & queued-request depth - primary trigger at 70% avg utilization over 30s, scale step +2 GPUs; emergency scale at 90% with immediate +4 bump and alert to ops
- Regional fallback: primary us-west-2, failover to us-east-1 read-only for LLM generation fallback (reduced throughput, same model shard)
- Canary/fallback: start with 20% traffic canary to new pool for 48h; automatic rollback if latency P95 > 750ms or error rate > 1.5%

I've attached a draft surge_playbook (docx) and a rough pool_topology diagram illustrating how burst routing would look. Monica will coordinate the handoff to CS/Implementation.

Next steps: can you confirm the regional constraints (do you need AP-symmetric coverage or are you US-only for now?) and confirm whether Optima requires a guaranteed pre-warmed burst window for scheduled batch jobs?

If that matches your expectations I can schedule a 30-min ops handshake with Sean and Monica to finalize the MOP and SLOs.

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: surge_playbook_draft.docx (draft)
Attachment: pool_topology_v2.png (diagram)

From: John Rivera <john.rivera@optimahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Lin <sara.lin@optimahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Surge capacity playbook & regional pool alignment for Optima Health

Marissa -

Appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side:
1) Region: Optima is US-only for production initially; we may add eu-west later in 2027 for compliance but not needed for go-live.
2) Scheduled jobs: we have nightly batch inference windows (02:00-04:00 local) that can create predictable bursts. We'd prefer a guaranteed warm window for those jobs - 2 GPUs pre-warmed 30m prior to start.
3) Failover behavior: when you say "read-only" fallback to us-east-1, does that mean model quality is identical or will we see precision degradation (we need to understand customer-facing risk).
4) Security/compliance: can you confirm whether the private deployment controls (VPC peering / KMS) will be in place for Dedicated? We need this documented in the SOW.

Happy to join the handshake meeting. Proposed availability: Thu 12/17 10:00-11:00 PT.

- John Rivera
Director, ML Ops | Optima Health

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Surge capacity playbook & regional pool alignment for Optima Health

Looping Sean in to cover technical MOP and KMS/VPC items John asked about. Quick internal plan so we present a single-source proposal at Thursday's meeting:

Action items for Sean:
- Confirm whether pre-warm API (reserveCapacity) can be scheduled +30m for 2 GPUs and ensure it doesn't affect autoscaler logic. If yes, add param in runbook.
- Validate model parity between regions: determine if we can use the same quantized variant in us-east-1 or if we must accept a lower-precision fallback. Provide expected change in PPL/latency.
- Prepare a short SOW clause for networking & KMS: VPC peering + customer-managed KMS key support + audit log retention (90 days). Use Optima deal_id OPT-44321.
- Draft a short escalation matrix for burst events (on-call SE -> CS -> Account Exec).

I'll consolidate your responses and produce an updated playbook + SOW snapshot to attach to the meeting invite.

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Optima_SOW_v1.pdf (redlined; internal draft)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Rivera <john.rivera@optimahealth.com>, Sara Lin <sara.lin@optimahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Surge capacity playbook & regional pool alignment for Optima Health

John / Sara -

Thanks - we confirmed the internal asks and have the initial artifacts ready for review. Summary of what Sean will bring to the call:
- Pre-warm capability: yes - we can schedule reserveCapacity for 2 GPUs at T-30m. Pre-warmed machines are accounted separately and will not trigger autoscale down during the window.
- Regional model parity: we can serve the same quantized model in us-east-1; expect a <3% quality delta on our canonical evals and P95 latency increase of ~120ms when routed to east. I'll have the calibration numbers in the meeting.
- Security: Optima_SOW_v1.pdf (attached) includes VPC peering, customer KMS support, and 90-day audit retention. Sean will confirm any networking exceptions live.
- Surge policy: we recommend the burst cap at 16 GPUs for on-demand bursts; scheduled bursts (the nightly batch) can be configured as guaranteed pre-warm windows per your request.

I scheduled a 30-min ops handshake for Thu 12/17 at 10:00 PT - calendar invite contains meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/0y7a8b. Please accept if that slot works.

Proposed meeting agenda (15m technical, 10m SOW/ops, 5m actions & owners):
1) Confirm reserveCapacity behavior and any network constraints
2) Review regional parity tradeoffs and rollback criteria
3) Finalize surge SLA thresholds and escalation path
4) Agree on immediate next steps + owner assignments

If anything else should be on the agenda, reply-all and I'll add.

Best -
Marissa
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Optima_SOW_v1.pdf
